markers.reading: The four adventurers stand in the underground tunnel at the statue-room door.

evidence.quote: four adventurers stand by a door in an underground tunnel

markers.reading: The opened door reveals four grotesque animated hybrid-animal statues.

evidence.quote: These four statues turn and look at you, as the door opens.
Each one is human size and as the door swings open, they all turned to look at you.

markers.reading: Delwath reopens the door and enters the center of the chamber.

evidence.quote: Okay, so Delwath opens the door again.
You can hear the sound of Delwath standing.

markers.reading: Wellby runs through the chamber, enduring the guardians’ opportunity attacks and shooting from within the encounter.

evidence.quote: Oh, just move through I guess.
As you draw the fire and run the gauntlet.

markers.reading: Kenzo rushes into the chamber to fight while Seeker casts from the doorway.

evidence.quote: So as Kenzo rushes into begin pummeling this one
I will run up to the door

markers.note: Seeker’s position remains at the doorway; only Kenzo is assigned this arrival.

markers.reading: After the fight the party follows the short rising tunnel to the stone wall and searches for an opening.

evidence.quote: the tunnel slopes upward and curve slightly and ends in a in a stone wall.
Right, let's head up there.
when you put your hand over and it feels like very intentional

markers.reading: Ghostly Gaze reveals an empty dusty antechamber beyond the stone wall.

evidence.quote: Beyond the wall is a looks like a basement or is like a sub basement of something
There's no people in there right now.

markers.reading: Delwath goes through the sliding secret door into the subbasement.

evidence.quote: You push the slides open. You see, the room you saw with ghostly gaze.
And I'll go through the wall.

markers.reading: Delwath sees two human-looking robed guards in the adjacent dark room beyond a broken opening.

evidence.quote: you also see two people humans that are kind of sitting inattentively in this room here.
This was Delwath.

markers.reading: The companions follow Delwath into the antechamber for the approaching guard; Seeker initially only pokes through its entrance.

evidence.quote: Here we come. I'll relay that message on and say it's time to rush in everyone.
I'll just barely be through the door like poke my head to the door.
He hasn't noticed Wellby given the distraction

markers.reading: The fighters move through the guardroom doorway to stop Breda at the ladder.

evidence.quote: I'm gonna step through the doorway
as far as I can get unfortunately but I will
I'll use my Cunning action to keep moving

markers.reading: Blown-open doors reveal cells and an apparently empty workshop; seeing them does not establish entry.

evidence.quote: it's probably gonna blow all the doors up yep
there are two prisoners slumped on the ground.

markers.reading: The party’s room inspection reveals the chaotic workshop, chest, ritual pole, and iron snake.

evidence.quote: Delwath is searching the rooms.
this room here looks like looks like a workshop

markers.reading: Delwath searches the workshop and Seeker approaches its iron cobra.

evidence.quote: I'm gonna just search the workshop, both for magical and mundane.
I'll just go check out the weird snake thing.
in the workshop

markers.reading: Wellby and Kenzo attend the cells; the prisoner is released and Seeker’s Healing Word revives him.

evidence.quote: Wellby and Kenzo what are you?
Got the keys release them.
this word of healing penetrates the cell and reaches this person.

markers.reading: The party gathers at the cells as Govir wakes.

evidence.quote: Your all now here

markers.reading: Kenzo goes to the bottom of the former rope-ladder opening to sense beings above.

evidence.quote: I'll go to the bottom of the stairs the bottom of the where the rope ladder was

markers.reading: Clairvoyance sees the leader and two guards eating a midday meal in the kitchen/dining room above.

evidence.quote: I'll send clairvoyance upstairs.
The sensor appears in a what looks like a small kitchen mess hall dining room.
The other two are just wearing robes

markers.note: The sensor is directed roughly two floors above the ladder room. Seeker does not physically enter the dining room during this observation.

markers.reading: Wellby and Seeker reset the rope ladder and conceal evidence in its room as an ambush trap.

evidence.quote: We put the ladder backup and move the big guys body out of the way
You put the ladder back.

markers.reading: The party brings Govir up through the tiny room and concealed tapestry doorway into the storage basement.

evidence.quote: Govir's going to come with us.
You jump up and you find yourself in a tiny five foot square completely blank room.
you come out into a basement.
Kenzo: So we're all together.

route.reading: Pass through the small room at the top of the rope ladder and push through the tapestry-concealed door.

markers.reading: From the wooden ladder Delwath looks through the trapdoor and walls, seeing the pantry and the dining-room leader writing notes.

evidence.quote: you climb up the ladder and look through the trap from inside
there was one person sitting at the table

markers.note: The line of sight passes through the pantry; this precedes physical entry upstairs.

markers.reading: Govir is with the party in the basement and is told to hide behind the barrels.

evidence.quote: limping behind you like sort of hiding in a corner
Govir, you go behind those barrels while we go upstairs

markers.reading: The adventurers ascend into the pantry and begin the dining-room assault; Seeker uses the pantry as cover.

evidence.quote: you're all gathering in the pantry and then proceeding with your attack
Yes, yeah yeah
as you all begin to move in the direction of the pantry

markers.reading: The attackers engage the werewolf leader in the dining room, with the ladder accompanying them.

evidence.quote: Wellby materializes
wail on him with my long sword.
I'll cast heat metal on him.

markers.reading: Kenzo closes on the dining-room leader and lands his first Stunning Strike from invisibility.

evidence.quote: Still invisible and I'm going to do a a stunning strike.
But it still takes the seven points of damage.

markers.reading: Seeker retreats from the dining-room fight to the top of the stairs.

evidence.quote: I'm gonna run this I'm gonna run up the stairs.
Up at the top of the stairs now

markers.reading: Seeker briefly moves down to cast mockery, then returns to the stair landing.

evidence.quote: I'll just say you move down move back up
I'll just leave you at the top of the stairs

route.reading: Briefly steps down toward the combat to cast, then withdraws.
